meta.description: Live UK graduate role scanner - source of truth. Rebuilt into dashboard.html by build_dashboard.py.
meta.portal_access_log: 2026-08-27 scan: the-trackr.com app pages JS-blank on plain fetch; gradcracker.com, brightnetwork.co.uk deadline pages, pwc.co.uk, goldmansachs.com, jobs.natwestgroup.com, careers.bbc.co.uk, totaljobs/CWJobs/technojobs returned 403/blank; targetjobs deadline page 404; ratemyplacement redirects to higherin.com. Roles from those sources verified via search-indexed employer content where possible; otherwise marked unconfirmed.
sourcing_rules: Only track roles that recruit into the UK. Leave off if unclear - never guess.
Only record a date from a UK-specific source (employer's own UK page or the actual UK posting). A global page listing UK cities among many is not enough.
date_confidence: 'confirmed' = UK source states it for the 2026/27 cycle; 'indicative' = UK source but rolling/prior-cycle/no year; 'unconfirmed' = no UK-specific source, date fields must be null.
Foreign-market dates are not applicable - do not record them.
Rolling roles with no deadline by design: status Open, deadline null, say so in notes. Never invent a deadline.
JS-rendered portals that return blank on plain fetch mean 'couldn't see it', not 'no roles'. Use a rendered-browser tool or record the portal as unreadable.
Job boards and trackers are discovery only, never the source of a date.

roles.title: Graduate Software Developer
roles.eligibility: Any degree, no prior programming required - BUT also requires A*AA at A-Level incl. A* Maths, which a BTEC route likely does not satisfy. Check with recruiter before investing time.
roles.notes: Rolling - no fixed deadline; employer page states still actively recruiting. Salary from GBP 60,000. Healthcare software (AI diagnostics, patient management).

roles.title: Graduate Programme - Software Engineering (incl. Manchester)
roles.location: Manchester, London, Leeds, Newcastle, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Birmingham, Bristol
roles.eligibility: Tech-related degree or strong coders from any STEM; confident in at least one major language. One role in one location per year - choose carefully. Office ~3 days/week. Visa sponsorship not stated.
roles.notes: No formal deadline - first come, first served; window closes when full. Manchester Software Engineering programme listed as open on Gradcracker/targetjobs (GBP 32,028 + GBP 5,000 signing bonus, starts Sept 2026 - Aug 2027). 2027 register-your-interest also live. Apply immediately when the stream you want is live.

roles.title: Technology Developer Graduate Programme (Expert Developer)
roles.eligibility: Must code in at least one language; STEM preferred but not required. 2026 cycle did not sponsor visas - right to work required; verify for 2027. Knutsford site is commutable from Manchester.
roles.notes: Employer page confirms Expert Developer + Explorer tracks but publishes no dates. Third-party trackers report ~1 Sept 2026 open / mid-Jan close for 2027 intake - unverified, check portal from 1 Sept. Technical assessment then assessment centre. Salary reported GBP 41-45k.

roles.title: Software Engineer Program (full-time 2027)
roles.eligibility: CS or related STEM with programming knowledge. Visa sponsorship not stated on UK pages.
roles.notes: Employer programme page only shows locations when a window is open - no UK window visible on plain fetch at last scan, so 2027 UK opening not yet verifiable. Classes fill on a rolling basis and close early; check portal weekly from early September. HireVue + coding assessment.

roles.title: New Analyst Programme - Engineering
roles.eligibility: Final-year students and graduates, any degree; Engineering favours CS/STEM.
roles.notes: Search-indexed GS page says 2027-cycle roles appear on the Students Application Page from 15 August; rolling review, deadlines vary by business - Engineering historically runs later (through December). goldmansachs.com blocked plain fetch (403) - verify on portal in a browser.

roles.title: Technology Engineering Graduate Scheme
roles.location: Manchester, Leeds, Halifax, Bristol, Edinburgh, London (hybrid)
roles.eligibility: New graduates through MSc/PhD; must know at least one modern programming language/framework. Third-party sources say 2:2 any discipline (unverified). Visa sponsorship not stated.
roles.notes: Employer page verified: currently closed with register-interest - 2027 cycle expected autumn 2026. GBP 47,000 + benefits, 2-year rotational (software engineering, DevOps, QA), GCP/Azure certifications included. Manchester is a named location. Closes early on volume - watch from September.

roles.title: Software Engineering Graduate Programme
roles.eligibility: STEM degree per prior cycle (2:1 in a STEM discipline); Digital Business & Technology may qualify - confirm with early-careers team. Visa sponsorship not stated.
roles.notes: jobs.natwestgroup.com returned 403 on every page - portal unreadable via plain fetch. Programme confirmed to exist via indexed employer content (2-year, 3-month bootcamp then live projects, ~GBP 33,500 + London allowance). Join NatWest Early Talent community; cycle typically opens autumn.

roles.title: Technology / Engineering Graduate Programme
roles.eligibility: Pathways: Software Engineering, Data, Cyber, Technical Business Analyst. Third-party sources say NO visa sponsorship - full UK right to work required (unverified on employer page).
roles.notes: Employer engineering page confirms Sheffield UK graduate programmes, but the find-a-programme listing is JS-driven and returned 0 results on plain fetch - effectively unreadable. Prior cycle opened early Sept, closed mid-Nov, rolling review. Join Talent Community for the open alert.

roles.title: Fast Stream 2027 - Digital scheme
roles.eligibility: 2:2 any subject for most streams (2:1 not required). Nationality rules apply - UK nationals and certain others; no visa sponsorship. Can rank multiple scheme preferences.
roles.notes: 2027-intake window expected to open early October 2026 and stay open only ~4 weeks (prior cycle: 9 Oct - 6 Nov) - exact dates not yet published, portal content truncated on plain fetch. Very short window: set a reminder for late September. Online tests then assessment centre.

roles.title: Software Engineering Graduate / Trainee Software Engineer
roles.eligibility: British citizens only; normally UK-resident 7 of last 10 years; security clearance required - no visa sponsorship possible.
roles.notes: Recruitment windows are ad hoc per role and clearance takes months. Prior-cycle salary ~GBP 32,092 + GBP 2,000 bonus. 2027 internship applications opened 24 Aug 2026; graduate roles post separately - check careers site directly. Manchester office is a real option.

roles.title: Graduate Software Engineer
roles.location: Warton/Samlesbury (Lancs), Sheffield, Glasgow, Portsmouth, other UK sites
roles.eligibility: 2:2 obtained or predicted in CS/Computing/Software Engineering. Security vetting min BPSS; many roles need NSV (typically 5-10 years UK residency) - effectively no sponsorship. North-West sites commutable from Manchester.
roles.notes: Employer page verified: 2026 early-careers closed, 'will reopen in September' - 2027 cycle expected Sept 2026. GBP 34,000 + GBP 2,000 welcome payment. Gradcracker still lists some rolling per-site roles with Jan/Apr 2027 starts. 18-30 month Accelerate framework.

roles.title: Technology Graduate Programme
roles.eligibility: Any degree for most streams (2:1 per third-party, not verified on employer page). Tracks: tech consulting, cyber, engineering/AI & data. Visa sponsorship not stated.
roles.notes: Employer early-careers page shows Technology programme status Open (checked 2026-08-27) with no fixed deadline - rolling, dates vary by programme and office, closes early on volume. 'Apply as early as possible' per Deloitte's own page.

roles.title: Technology & Engineering Graduate Programmes
roles.eligibility: No technical background required for several tracks (Technology Consulting, Technology Engineering, Technology Audit, Powered Applications). Visa sponsorship not stated.
roles.notes: Employer page verified: 'Sign up to hear first when we open' - 2027 cycle not yet open, KPMG typically opens autumn and closes early on volume. 3-year programmes with AWS/Google/Microsoft certifications included. Join the talent community now.

roles.title: Technology Graduate Programme
roles.eligibility: Any degree for most consulting tracks; details published when applications reopen.
roles.notes: Employer page verified: '2026 Applications are now closed', reopening 'later in the year' - i.e. autumn 2026 for the 2027 intake. Rolling once open - apply early. Join talent community for the open alert.

roles.title: Technology and AI Graduate Programme

roles.notes: pwc.co.uk returned 403 on every careers page - portal unreadable via plain fetch. Third-party: 2026 intake closed 1 Jun 2026; 2027 portal expected to reopen Aug-Sept 2026, i.e. around now. Rolling with early closure. Verify in a browser this week.

roles.title: Graduate Software Engineering Programme
roles.location: UK - varies by cycle (2026 was Telford)
roles.eligibility: Bachelor's/Master's in CS, Software Engineering or related STEM. Only ONE application per season allowed - choose your role carefully. ~3 days/week office. Visa sponsorship not stated.
roles.notes: 2026 posting now 'position has been filled'. Employer FAQ: recruitment season runs September-August - 2027-cycle roles expected from Sept 2026. Permanent contract from day one.

roles.title: Software Development Engineer - Graduate (2026 req)
roles.eligibility: Bachelor's+ in CS/Computer Engineering/Data Science/Information Systems or related STEM; graduated within last 24 months qualifies (2026 grads eligible). Requires one general-purpose language - C# and TypeScript both count. Visa sponsorship not stated.
roles.notes: Live posting verified on amazon.jobs with active Apply button (2026-08-27). Rolling - no deadline published, closes when filled. Online assessment (coding + work style). A 2027-labelled req likely appears autumn 2026. No Manchester office - relocation required.

roles.title: Software Engineering Graduate Programme
roles.eligibility: 2:2+ in a technology-related field - Digital Business & Technology qualifies. NO visa sponsorship: page states Graduate Route Visa not accepted. May close early on application volume.
roles.notes: GBP 35,000 + GBP 1,000 sign-on. Apply button live on employer page (verified 2026-08-27); page also references Jan-Mar 2026 assessment centres, so double-check the intake year before applying.

roles.title: Software Engineering Graduates (Digital)
roles.location: Belfast (Consumer Digital; other tech roles vary)
roles.eligibility: Technology-related degree (CS, computer engineering, networking, IT, data). NO visa sponsorship - full UK right to work for scheme duration.
roles.notes: Employer content page verified: 2-year programme, 3-stage process (application, untimed online assessment, in-person assessment event). No dates published; BT grad roles typically post autumn-winter on jobs.bt.com.

roles.title: Software Engineering Graduate Scheme
roles.eligibility: No degree-class requirement - practical coding from a degree, bootcamp or self-taught accepted. Right to work in UK for programme duration required.
roles.notes: careers.bbc.co.uk blocked plain fetch - portal unreadable. Prior cycle: closed 14 Dec 2025, GBP 35,205 (GBP 40,464 London), 2 years / four 6-month rotations, take-home tech test then assessment days. 2027 posting expected ~autumn 2026. Salford is a named hub - strong for Manchester.

roles.title: Data Graduate Programme (no SWE scheme visible this cycle)
roles.eligibility: Any degree; final-year students or graduates. Right to work in UK required by start date - NO sponsorship.
roles.notes: Employer page verified: Data programme 'now closed' - register interest for next cycle. GBP 35,000, 2 years, 3 rotations. No dedicated software engineering grad scheme visible on Sky's current lineup (Data, Creative, Business, Finance); programmes change year to year - re-check in autumn.

roles.title: Graduate Software Developer (Graduate Academy)
roles.eligibility: Open to graduates seeking a permanent role; no specific degree or grade stated.
roles.notes: Employer page verified: graduate jobs 'typically open in September' for an October-following-year start - expect Sept 2026 opening; no live grad vacancies at last check. Two-year Academy, pairing/code-review culture, Manchester HQ. Small intake - closes fast. Top target for a Manchester-based full-stack dev.

roles.title: Compass Software Engineering Graduate Programme (Manchester)

roles.notes: Employer page verified: 12-month rotational programme in Manchester, Sept 2026 start, applications opened Jan 2026 - current cycle largely complete; next cycle likely opens ~Jan 2027. Permanent role on completion. CV, take-home test, recruiter call, assessment centre.
